review_candidates.title: Linux Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Fyld is hiring: Linux Systems Administrator At Fyld, we believe the future is built with people, technology, and strong values. We're looking for an experienced Linux Systems Administrator with strong infrastructure skills and hands-on experience managing Linux environments. Your Profile Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field Minimum of 4 years of professional experience as a Linux Systems Administrator or in a similar role Strong experience
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We're looking for an experienced Linux Systems Administrator with strong infrastructure skills and hands-on experience managing Linux environments. Your Profile Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field Minimum of 4 years of professional experience as a Linux Systems Administrator or in a similar role Strong experience in the administration, configuration and maintenance of Linux systems Hands-on experience with Red Hat, Ubuntu, Debian or similar Linux distributions Strong knowledge of Linux command line and Bash scripting Experience with system monitoring, troubleshooting and performance optimisation Good knowledge of networking fundamentals , including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and SSH Experience administering web servers , such as Apache or Nginx Good understanding of storage, filesystems, permissions, users and access management Experience
